modules.name: Molecular design and structural priors
modules.paper_role: Define photoinitiator families, donor/acceptor roles and structural requirements before graph-model interpretation.
modules.evidence_role: Source-linked structural and domain rules; molecular identities.

modules.name: Six-task property rationale and optical evidence
modules.paper_role: Connect literature requirements to the six fixed model endpoints and separate measured optical context from computed proxy labels.
modules.evidence_role: Property candidates and endpoint definitions; no model labels generated from text anchors.

modules.name: Photoinitiation mechanism and admissibility
modules.paper_role: Support Type-I, Type-II and SET/PET roles with source-specific context and limits.

modules.name: Formulation, exposure and polymerization context
modules.paper_role: Explain how formulation and laser conditions affect observed initiation and processing outcomes.
modules.evidence_role: Condition candidates and context groups; processing results remain separate from intrinsic molecular properties.

modules.name: Synthesis and materialisation evidence
modules.paper_role: Support family-level route feasibility and the synthetic-accessibility rationale.
modules.evidence_role: Route precedents with applicability and evidence class; separate from numerical accessibility scores.

observation_definition: A source-anchored scalar candidate; compound ownership and experimental conditions may still be unresolved.
